facts.en: Completed a nursery retail certificate at Fictional Ferncopper Institute in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构蕨铜学院完成苗圃零售证书课程。

facts.en: Paid greenhouse stock assistant at Fictional Sunmoth Nursery from 2022-03 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-03 至 2026-08 在虚构日蛾苗圃任有薪温室库存助理。

facts.en: Labeled trays with crop batch references, moved approved stock between the propagation and sales areas and logged those moves.
facts.zh: 为育苗盘标注作物批次编号，在繁育区与销售区之间搬运获批库存，并记录这些搬运。

facts.en: Counted visible live seedlings in assigned trays and recorded empty or damaged cells separately.
facts.zh: 清点指定育苗盘中可见的活苗，并单独记录空穴或受损穴位。

facts.en: Prepared plant orders from the grower’s pick list and checked labels before dispatch.
facts.zh: 依据栽培负责人的拣货单准备植物订单，并在发运前核对标签。

facts.en: Watered assigned benches according to the grower’s written schedule and logged completed rounds.
facts.zh: 按栽培负责人书面计划为指定苗床浇水，并记录已完成的巡回浇灌。

facts.en: Flagged discoloured leaves and unusual pest signs to the grower, who decided isolation and treatment actions.
facts.zh: 将叶片变色及异常虫害迹象报告给栽培负责人，由其决定隔离及处理措施。

facts.en: Helped reconcile a seedling batch count in 2025-04.
facts.zh: 2025-04 协助核对一批幼苗数量。

facts.en: That check covered 10 trays with 40 cells each and counted 372 visible live seedlings on the inspection date.
facts.zh: 该检查涵盖 10 个育苗盘，每盘 40 个穴位，并在检查当天清点到 372 株可见活苗。

facts.en: The source does not record the original seeds sown, their sowing dates or prior removals for that batch.
facts.zh: 来源未记录该批次最初播种的种子数量、播种日期或此前移走的植株。

facts.en: Personally recorded the tray-level counts; the grower decided which plants were ready for sale.
facts.zh: 个人记录各育苗盘数量；哪些植株可供销售由栽培负责人决定。

facts.en: Uses batch-label templates, handheld stock scanners and spreadsheet totals.
facts.zh: 使用批次标签模板、手持库存扫描器及电子表格汇总。

facts.en: Maintained a damaged-pot log and asked the stock lead to approve replacements.
facts.zh: 维护花盆损坏日志，并请库存负责人批准更换。

facts.en: Completed the nursery’s internal watering and stock-movement induction in 2022-03.
facts.zh: 2022-03 完成苗圃内部浇水及库存搬运入职培训。

facts.en: Built a personal windowsill herb diary in 2023 with photographs and self-recorded watering dates.
facts.zh: 2023 年制作个人窗台香草日记，含照片及自行记录的浇水日期。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Willowseed Community Garden on alternate Sundays during 2024-05 to 2024-09.
facts.zh: 2024-05 至 2024-09 隔周星期日在虚构柳籽社区花园做志愿者。

facts.en: At the community garden, helped label donated pots and prepared visitor planting tables under the garden lead’s instructions.
facts.zh: 在社区花园按花园负责人说明，协助标记捐赠花盆并准备访客种植台。

facts.en: Suggested a colour-coded empty-pot area at the nursery in 2025-11; the stock lead approved a small trial on one bench.
facts.zh: 2025-11 在苗圃建议设置颜色编码空花盆区域；库存负责人批准在一个苗床上小规模试行。

facts.en: Enjoys printing leaf-shaped patterns on scrap paper.
facts.zh: 爱好在废纸上印制叶形图案。

facts.en: No pesticide application, independent plant-disease diagnosis or crop-breeding work is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录施用农药、独立诊断植物病害或作物育种工作。
